reason: As the child meets it, the only hard thing on this card is the headword. A child who knows 'transparent' takes 'clear' at once. 'glass' and 'window' are things that are transparent, not words that mean it, and the associated-not-same hint names that move. 'opaque' is a pull only on a child who half-knows the KS2 science pair and muddles which way round it goes. That is the same mechanism as 'false' on genuine/real or 'strong' on feeble/frail at T3. On whether opaque is the hard part: it is not. A child who knows opaque is the opposite but does not know transparent cannot use that, because she still has to know transparent to pick clear. A child who knows neither faces a word she cannot read whatever the tier, and that gap is exactly what the headword's vault tier measures. opaque is a harder word than any T3 opposite (friendly, false, strong, eager, important), and that is the one argument for T4. But no calibration item tiers by its distractor's difficulty: jubilant/dejected sits at T4 with its headword, not above it. The card's structure, one opposite and two associated nouns with clear the only adjective besides opaque, is the T3 shape exactly (genuine: real/false/gold/antique; feeble: frail/strong/illness/cane; trivial: unimportant/important/detail/penny). Calibration on bare against carried: for the same headword the bank card normally sits at the SAME tier as the generated item (genuine 3/3, feeble 3/3, reluctant 3/3, jubilant 4/4, conceal 4/4, exhausted 4/4, notorious 5/5, exquisite 5/5, benevolent 5/5). The exceptions are one step, both ways (stoic 5/4, hostile and humble 3/2). With the carried transparent item at T3 since R1054 and the vault at 3, T3 is the norm and T5 is two steps outside any pairing in the bank. This item's tier is authored, so nothing aligns it automatically. That is why it needs this record: left at T5, it would serve one of the easiest bare cards in the type to the children it is meant to stretch, two steps above its own vault word and its carried sibling, with nothing reporting the disagreement. Scope: this changes the tier only. Annie's APPROVED event (rev-0001, 2026-08-06) is on content this re-tier does not touch, and my record sits beside hers without speaking for her. There is no signature to void. The bare-card two-part screen holds: no distractor is correct in transparent's other sense, which would be 'obvious'.
